comparisonMode: Exact path and SHA-256; bytes used only for hashing, no content inspection. Sensitive path names are skipped before any file read. Only regular files are hashed.

exclusions: Ignored outputs outside the baseline historical-live roots are not inventoried. This report itself is created after the inventory snapshot.

trackedWorkingTree.note: Tracked wave1 product changes are separate from preservation of pre-existing untracked/historical evidence.

canonicalDiscovery.reasonForSrcFilter: The src filter retains the full canonical corpus; explicit new file paths extend include before staging. Passing only the two file paths would narrow execution to those tests.
